gifts: Makeblock mBot Ranger STEM robot kit
recommendation.rationale: These gifts let Noah design, code, and bring his own robots to life, matching his love for programming. Each set is built for ages 8‑12, offers hands‑on building, and introduces real coding concepts in a fun, safe way. Santa’s present will spark imagination and give hours of creative play.

wish.text: Dear Noah, at ten years old you’ve become a brilliant inventor, and the North Pole elves have heard about your curious mind. I’ve tucked a magical little explorer, a lively building kit, and a sparkling code‑casting companion into your stocking, ready for wondrous adventures. Merry Christmas!
